label: Firefly III
agentGuide: Base path /api/v1; answers are JSON:API: data[].attributes. Accounts: GET /api/v1/accounts?type=asset (name, current_balance, currency_code); transactions: GET /api/v1/transactions?start=2026-01-01&end=2026-01-31&type=withdrawal&limit=50 (attributes.transactions[] with description, amount, date, source_name, destination_name, category_name, budget_name); search: GET /api/v1/search/transactions?query=<words>. Budgets: GET /api/v1/budgets, spent: GET /api/v1/budgets/<id>/limits; categories: GET /api/v1/categories; bills: GET /api/v1/bills. Add: POST /api/v1/transactions {"transactions": [{"type": "withdrawal", "date": "2026-10-01", "amount": "12.50", "description": "...", "source_id": 1, "destination_name": "Shop"}]}. Summary: GET /api/v1/summary/basic?start=&end=. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, amounts strings.
